description: This file defines the AssetRepository class, providing CRUD operations, existence checks, soft delete functionality, and subordinate resource management for assets in a PostgreSQL database within a data asset management system. It includes methods for assets, their properties, statuses, related IDs, input parameters, control device mappings, and layered delete operations with dependency handling.

classes.name: AssetRepository
classes.description: Repository class encapsulating data access logic for assets, including CRUD, verification, soft deletion, and cascading dependent resource management.

classes.name: AssetRepository.EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception class thrown when a specified asset entity is not found during validation.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset record in the database based on provided request data and returns the created AssetDto.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset by its ID if not soft-deleted; returns null if not found.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset with new data; returns the updated AssetDto or null if the asset was not found.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Performs filtered queries for assets based on various optional criteria, returning a list of matching AssetDto objects.

methods.name: AssetExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks whether an asset with a given ID exists and is not soft-deleted.

methods.name: SoftDeleteAssetGraphAsync
methods.description: Performs a cascade soft delete of an asset and associated dependent rows across multiple related tables, returning true if deletion occurred.

methods.name: InputParameterBelongsToAssetAsync
methods.description: Verifies if a specific input parameter belongs to a given asset and is not deleted.

methods.name: ThroughputEquationBelongsToInputAsync
methods.description: Checks if a throughput equation belongs to a specified input parameter and is not deleted.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates a status log record for an asset and returns the created AssetStatusLogDto.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of status logs for an asset, excluding soft-deleted entries.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific asset status log by its ID for a given asset; returns null if not found or not under asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates a status log under an asset, returning the updated AssetStatusLogDto or null if not found.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new additional asset ID for an asset and returns the created AdditionalAssetIdDto.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all non-deleted additional asset IDs associated with an asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific additional asset ID under an asset, returns null if not found or soft-deleted.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing additional asset ID associated with an asset, returns the updated DTO or null if not found.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates an asset property record for an asset, returning the created AssetPropertyDto.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of non-deleted properties for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific property of an asset by ID; returns null if not found or deleted.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates an asset property record; returns the updated DTO or null if not found.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a mapping between an asset and a control device, returning the created ControlDeviceMappingDto.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists all control device mappings for an asset, excluding soft-deleted entries.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific control device mapping by ID under an asset scope; returns null if not found.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device mapping; returns the updated DTO or null if not found.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates an input parameter record under an asset and returns the created InputParameterDto.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of input parameters for an asset, excluding soft-deleted.

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific input parameter by ID under an asset; returns null if not found.

methods.name: UpdateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Updates an input parameter under an asset; returns the updated DTO or null if not found.

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a parent input mapping for a child input parameter, returning the created ParentInputMappingDto.
